FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The once-majestic halls now echo with the hum of ancient machinery, as if the very fabric of time itself has been warped.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a man in his late 40s with a wild shock of white hair, sits upon his throne. His eyes gleam with a knowing intensity as he surveys his kingdom. The walls, once adorned with the proud coats of arms, now display a riotous tapestry of neon hues and glitching patterns.

EVERARD
(to his advisor, Lord Ravenswood)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era, one where our empire's aesthetic is reborn in the spirit of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

RAVENSWOOD
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But what of tradition?

EVERARD
(smirking)
Tradition is for the weak. We must forge a new path, one that blends the best of our heritage with the... (he waves his hand, as if conjuring the very essence of vaporwave)...dreamscapes of the future.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's courtyard, once a tranquil oasis, now throbs with the pulsing rhythms of a forgotten era. The sound of distant machinery and the whispers of ancient incantations mingle with the sweet scent of blooming flowers.

EVERARD
(to his courtiers)
Behold, my friends! The dawn of a new era. Our empire's aesthetic, once a bastion of tradition, now soars on the wings of innovation.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - LATER

The room is now a kaleidoscope of colors and patterns, as if the very walls have been transformed into a psychedelic dreamscape. The king's advisors and courtiers move through the space with a newfound sense of freedom, their footsteps echoing off the walls as they dance to the beat of an unheard rhythm.

EVERARD
(standing, his eyes aglow with excitement)
We shall call this new era... (he pauses, a sly smile spreading across his face)...the Era of Eternal Summer.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The castle's walls, once a proud testament to the power of the crown, now seem to shimmer and writhe like a living thing. The air is thick with the scent of ozone and burning incense, as if the very fabric of reality has been torn asunder.

EVERARD
(standing atop the castle walls, his voice carrying on the wind)
The Era of Eternal Summer has begun. Let the world tremble before our... (he pauses, a mischievous glint in his eye)...glitching majesty.

FADE TO BLACK.
